data.explanation: The tax office (Finanzamt Musterhöhe) has processed your 2025 income tax return and calculated a refund (Guthaben) of €713.00, which it will transfer to your bank account automatically — no action is needed to receive it. If you disagree with the calculation (for example the deductions applied), you have the right to file an objection (Einspruch); the app shows the deadline for this above. Doing nothing simply means the assessment becomes final as calculated. For complex disagreements you may want advice from a tax advisor (Steuerberater).

items.title: Deadline to object (Einspruch) to the tax assessment
items.action: If you disagree with the assessment, file an objection (Einspruch) with Finanzamt Musterhöhe in writing, via the ELSTER portal, or orally for the record.
items.consequence: If you do not object by the deadline shown, the assessment becomes final and cannot be challenged afterwards.
